channel.description: Latest articles from UK Defence Journal (ukdefencejournal.org.uk)

item.title: UK develops mobile quantum scanner to study blast effects
item.description: The UK is developing what it describes as the world’s first fully mobile quantum brain scanner designed to measure the effects of blast exposure on military personnel directly at training and operational sites. The post UK develops mobile quantum scanner to study blast effects first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: U.S. Navy takes delivery of new destroyer
item.description: The U.S. Navy has formally accepted delivery of the future USS Ted Stevens (DDG-128), a Flight III Arleigh Burke-class guided missile destroyer. The post U.S. Navy takes delivery of new destroyer first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: American B-52 bombers to get comfier seats
item.description: The U.S. Air Force has completed flight testing of an adaptive seat cushion for the B-52H Stratofortress aimed at reducing aircrew fatigue during long-duration missions. The post American B-52 bombers to get comfier seats first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: New nuclear attack submarine to join American fleet
item.description: Once commissioned, Idaho will join the fleet as a multi-mission attack submarine, with roles that include anti-submarine warfare, anti-surface warfare, intelligence collection and support to special operations forces. The post New nuclear attack submarine to join American fleet first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: U.S. combat aircraft over Venezuelan capital amid explosions
item.description: Incoming reports from Caracas show explosions alongside low-altitude flights by CH-47 Chinook aircraft. The post U.S. combat aircraft over Venezuelan capital amid explosions first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: Another defence site attacked by Palestine group in Scotland
item.description: A defence site near Edinburgh was attacked in an incident linked to pro-Palestine activism, with a break-in reported at premises on Eskmills Road, Musselburgh. Police enquiries are ongoing. The post Another defence site attacked by Palestine group in Scotland first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: US helicopter opens fire on Venezuelan military facility
item.description: Video footage circulating from Caracas appears to show a helicopter conducting a rocket attack against ground targets during the overnight strikes in Venezuela. The post US helicopter opens fire on Venezuelan military facility first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: An update on U.S. strikes in Venezuela
item.description: This was not a full-scale invasion, but rather a limited and focused military action involving air and special operations forces, supported by strikes. The post An update on U.S. strikes in Venezuela first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: Maduro captured and flown out of Venezuela after US strikes
item.description: US President Donald Trump has claimed that Venezuelan President Nicolás Maduro has been captured and removed from the country following what he described as a large-scale US military operation overnight. The post Maduro captured and flown out of Venezuela after US strikes first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: British and French jets strike target in Syria
item.description: Royal Air Force aircraft have conducted joint airstrikes against an Islamic State underground facility in Syria alongside French forces. The post British and French jets strike target in Syria first appeared on UK Defence Journal.
